title: JPL manager: life on Mars means death for JPL
summary: Jesse Michels tells of JPL manager: life on Mars means death for JPL, about unspecified at Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: said one of the managements people had said at Jet Propulsion Lab, um, they were talking about finding life on Mars and one manager had scolded the rest of the managers saying, "Don't you realize that life on Mars means death for JPL?

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, relays a story he credits to the author Whitley Strieber about the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's space mission center in Pasadena, California. According to the story, when managers there were discussing finding life on Mars, one scolded the others: "Don't you realize that life on Mars means death for JPL?" If true, it would suggest people had reasons not to announce such a discovery.
